exposure: trajectories of comorbid anxiety and depressive (CAD) symptoms
cohort: 1682 Dutch-speaking pregnant women with a gestational age at birth ≥37 weeks, without multiple pregnancy, severe psychiatric disorder, or chronic disease history
finding: Persistently high levels of comorbid anxiety and depressive symptoms throughout pregnancy were associated with a lower likelihood of physiological birth.
mod_finding: The study found that persistently high levels of comorbid anxiety and depressive symptoms throughout pregnancy were associated with a lower likelihood of physiological birth.
